evidence: docs/ticket-model.md:12-17 lists five user-facing types and states 'session_log is a gate/lifecycle-exempt type documented ... not here'
common.schema.json:17 ticket_type enum includes internal 'code_review' and 'identity'; :9 ticket_status includes lifecycle 'archived'/'deleted'
search of docs/ticket-model.md finds no mention of code_review/identity; 'archived' appears only incidentally (line 93)
findings.finding: Fitness-for-purpose tension: the hand-maintained prose in docs/ticket-model.md deliberately documents a curated USER-FACING subset — 5 types (task/story/bug/epic/session_log, with session_log noted as 'documented ... not here') and 5 statuses (open/in_progress/blocked/closed/idea) — and never mentions code_review, identity, archived, or deleted. The AC commits to emitting 'all seven current types and statuses' into a block adjacent to that curated prose. The plan does not say how the generated all-seven block reconciles with the surrounding narrative that intentionally scopes out internal/lifecycle types, risking a doc that contradicts itself.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria (bullet 2: 'includes all seven current types and statuses') / docs/ticket-model.md:12-17

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State the marker/delimiter convention (e.g. `<!-- BEGIN GENERATED TAXONOMY -->` / `<!-- END GENERATED TAXONOMY -->`) that bounds the generated block and that the drift check and prose-preservation both key off.
evidence: Approach: 'Generate a marked taxonomy section ... Preserve hand-maintained relationship documentation outside the generated section.'
AC2: 'leaves current relationship prose untouched' — depends on a defined boundary between generated and hand-maintained content.
findings.finding: The marker/delimiter convention that bounds the generated taxonomy block is not specified, so the drift check and the 'leaves relationship prose untouched' requirement depend on an unstated boundary format.
scenarios: The generator overwrites hand-maintained prose because the block boundary was never defined
The drift check greps the wrong region
findings.suggested_fix: Specify explicit BEGIN/END HTML-comment markers around the generated block; the generator only rewrites content between them and the drift check compares only that region.
